description: The SVG source of one icon in the chosen style and corner radius. Paints with currentColor.

name.description: Exact icon name from search_icons, like calendar-event.

radius.description: Corner radius: sharp, regular or round. Default regular.

size.description: Width and height in pixels. Default 24.

strokeWidth.description: Stroke width for line, duocolor and duotone. Default 2.

style.description: line, duocolor, duotone, fill or bulk. Default line.

name: get_icon
title: Get coolicons SVG
